card.name: Software release and version announcements
card.fires_on: Small words in software-product text where the next word could plausibly be "release", such as "other", "of", "is now" after a product name or version number, in announcements and documentation.

modes.label: Release news
modes.description: Words just after a product launch or version mention, where release or version wording could follow.
modes.example: That?s changing with last week?s release of Windows Vista, the next-generation operating system for personal computers. Along with many<< other>> innovative improvements that make it easier to find

modes.label: Version notes
modes.description: Words in "As of Coherence 3.0" style version notes in software documentation.

modes.label: Product announcement
modes.description: Verb or adverb after a product name and version in a press release.
modes.example: EON Raptor(TM) 5.5<< is>> now a free software for serious games.

card.writes: It pushes the word "release" (and releasing) as the next word, and pushes away unrelated software words like fork and projects.
card.plain: It fires in software news and documentation on small words where the next word could be "release".
